# P1.13 — Figures: the visualize workflow and render worker

Spec: `docs/tickets/41_P1.13__figures.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.13.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (dev deploy + migration `0034` + one
real `visualize` end-to-end + the container-level resvg check, ≤$3) is operator-gated →
**D-P1.13-1**.

## Summary

Figures become first-class, honesty-preserving assets (§7.5; REQ-VIZ-1…16, REQ-WF-14). A
figure is a claim-bearing asset, never an image the model happened to draw: **provenance is
resolved before a spec is generated**, numbers remembered by the model are never silently
rendered, rendering is deterministic and server-side, iterations are versioned, insertion is
proposal-only, frozen drafts fork, and `[unverified data]` persists through Review/export.

**Contracts** (`@rhema/contracts`, `domain/figure.ts` + sidecars): `FigureAsset` /
`FigureSpecKind` (`vega_lite` | `mermaid` | `table`), the six provenance kinds
(`selection`/`claim_ledger`/`asset_upload`/`fetched`/`user_typed`/`none`), verification states,
alt ≤250 + `sourceLine`-before-insert gates, the `figureBlockMarkdown` builder +
`<!-- rhema:figure id=… version=n -->` marker round-trip, the entry-point→provenance map for
all five entries, `figureClaims`/`figureClaimsSupported`/`verificationFromVerdicts` (the
deterministic Review half — `kind:"none"` inventories Unsupported by construction), the
export-package shape, and the `figure.json` sidecar (registry + fixture).

**Renderer** (`@rhema/figures`, new package): Vega-Lite → `vega-lite` compile → `vega` render
to byte-identical light+dark SVG themed from `@rhema/tokens` (one neutral palette, label
contrast ≥4.5:1 asserted, no animation); Mermaid → `beautiful-mermaid` (MIT — §16.3 #22);
GFM/HTML tables pass through unrendered; `validateVegaLiteSpec` returns the validator-feedback
list the spec phase retries against (≤3); `renderPng2x` via `@resvg/resvg-js` (MPL-2.0 —
exception entry, §16.3 #8), lazy and worker-only.

**Protocols** (`figure` workflow, Rhema-owned): `skills/figure` declared `rhemaOwned`;
four-phase manifest — **data** (judge: the honesty step — classify origin, refuse
model-memory numbers, insist ⇒ `kind:"none"`) → **spec** (generate, ≤3 retries with validator
feedback) → **render** (package) → **caption** (generate); no Approval — the preview card is
the consent. `ESTIMATORS.figure` per REQ-VIZ-16 (first 5–15, iterate 2–8, chips 0); `<fig>`
declared-path placeholder resolves the server-minted figure id at hydration/runspec;
`WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS.figure` + `SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW` + sidecar registry rows.

**Orchestrator + worker**: `figure-delivery.ts` folds the committed render package into
`figures` + `figure_versions` (iterate ⇒ n+1 retaining prior spec/data/provenance); a
committed `render` step enqueues `figure.render` (post-commit, singleton-keyed on
(figure, run, attempt)); the worker handler renders the persisted light+dark pair, pins
`renderedVersionId`, emits `figure.rendered`, and lazily produces `render@2x.png`.
`figure-claims.ts` derives the Tier-1 claim inventory from `provenance.json` + `data.csv` +
the spec (value/label/axis-range/caption-comparison claims; document-order figure numbers)
and mounts `.rhema/figure-claims.json` into review/fact_check hydration; delivered verdicts
write `claims.figure_id` back into `provenance.verification` (verified/contradicted/
unverifiable) and re-persist `provenance.json`.

**API** (`figure-routes.ts` + run-routes figure branch): the `/visualize` sheet's POST is the
only run creator — the figure branch mints/verifies the figure id (a client-invented id
404s), seeds `figures.provenance` from the entry point's `sourceRefs` (URL ⇒ `fetched`,
asset ⇒ `asset_upload`, claims ⇒ `claim_ledger`, typed rows ⇒ `user_typed`, selection ⇒
`selection`, insist ⇒ `none`), and freezes the figure facts into `runs.inputs`. Card routes:
pane list, card DTO, PATCH (alt ≤250, `sourceLine` gate), data corrections ⇒ `user_typed`,
spec-chip edits (0 cr) + version restore — both enqueue a runless rerender — propose/accept/
reject (accept writes the block at the anchor in one transaction; a frozen draft forks
`v(N+1)` via `saveManualRevision` and marks its claims pending verification; reject keeps the
asset), and the lazy `png` endpoint.

**Web**: `/p/:slug/figures` pane + `/p/:slug/figures/:figureId` card (type chips, caption/alt/
source fields, Data/Spec/Versions disclosures, insert-after anchor picker, persistent
`[unverified data]` badge) + `/p/:slug/visualize` sheet. All five entries converge on the
sheet: chat `/visualize …` redirects (never an inline run), the selection popover's Visualize,
the ⌘K palette verb (`figure` workflow → `/visualize`, scopes serialized to provenance
seeds), Edit figure on an inserted block, and the craft finding's Visualize action. Assistant
`runSheetResult` returns the sheet payload for `workflow:"figure"` — never a run id.
Review/dossier: figure-linked Tier-1 claims carry the figure chip/link.

## Notes

- The **`/visualize` sheet is the only figure run creator** — every entry point resolves to
  it (chat verb, popover, palette, block edit, craft finding); nothing creates a run inline.
- `figure.render` is a **worker job, not a run phase** and never the browser's job — the
  canonical SVG is server-rendered; the browser lazy-loads PNG@2x through the api.
- The `figure` workflow carries **no Approval** by design (REQ-VIZ-16): the preview-before-
  insert proposal card IS the consent checkpoint; propose never mutates the draft.
- A `kind:"none"` figure is a REFUSE-default the author may insist past — never an approval:
  the claims inventory with no refs, the badge persists everywhere including exports.
- Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-12-outline-workflow`; merge operator-held per the chain's
  mergePolicy.
